claimed_coverage: Tests that the _get_metadata_from_chat_choice method safely handles missing logprobs attribute by returning None instead of raising AttributeError, covering both regular Choice and ChunkChoice objects.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix at line 201 in open_ai_chat_completion_base.py changes `choice.logprobs` to `getattr(choice, 'logprobs', None)` to safely access the logprobs attribute that may be absent in Azure OpenAI responses.
issue_context_used: The issue describes that Azure OpenAI responses may not include the logprobs field, causing AttributeError; the tests verify that metadata extraction handles this gracefully by returning None.
notes: Created 5 hidden tests using pytest with unittest.mock to verify the logprobs attribute safety fix. Tests cover: (1) Choice with logprobs present, (2) Choice without logprobs attribute (key bug case), (3) Choice with logprobs=None, (4) ChunkChoice with logprobs, (5) ChunkChoice without logprobs. The tests correctly fail on buggy code and pass when fix is applied.
